from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancials(BaseModel):
    """The financial result extracted from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the filing belongs to")
    net_profit_value: float | None = Field(description="The Net Profit or Loss amount; losses should be negative for comparison")
    reporting_label: str | None = Field(description="The label used in the document (e.g. 'Net loss', 'Net income')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The financial reporting period covered by the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financials: list[CompanyFinancials]
